title: Sydney Attack Victim Identified
body: Rabbi Yaakov Levitan, a Chabad shliach, was killed in a terror attack in Sydney. He played a key role in several Jewish institutions, known for his professionalism and reliability.

title: Sydney Attack Victim Identified
body: Rabbi Reuven Morrison, 62, a Chabad community member, was killed in the Sydney terror shooting. He split time between Melbourne and Sydney through business and communal ties.

title: Sydney Terror Attack Victim
body: Holocaust survivor Alex Kleytman Hy”d, a retired civil engineer, was fatally shot at a Sydney Chanukah event, authorities confirmed.
